method.animation_assessment: Inspected all 17 decoded idle-jump-idle frames and all 16 decoded look-loop frames in ordered strips. Actual playback timing and smoothness were not directly observed.
method.measurements: Alpha bounds and head-region widths taken from exact current encoded WebP.

checks.name: idle_jump_scale_continuity
checks.evidence: The previously enlarged crouched takeoff is gone. Jumping frame 0 and landing frame 4 closely match idle apparent head size, torso length and whole-body height. Uppermost 50-pixel alpha-region widths are idle0=76 px and jumping0-4=77,80,78,77,77 px (about 1-5% variation). The apex uppermost-60-pixel width is 88 px because the raised hands enter that region; the head-only upper 50 px remains 78 px. Ordered frames do not show the previous broadening/shrinking on entry or landing.

checks.name: actual_jump_and_landing
checks.evidence: Exact any-alpha lower bounds are y=204,197,185,197,204 for jumping frames 0-4, versus idle y=204. Feet visibly rise, peak 19 px above idle baseline, descend and land at the same baseline. Arm and lower-garment/leg pose changes reinforce a small hop. No stationary ground-pinned jump.

checks.name: jump_alignment_identity
checks.evidence: Jump remains centered and uses the same character, face, hair, jewelry, clothing, palette, and outline treatment as idle. Small natural drawing/pose variations remain, without conspicuous proportion or registration jumps. Landing matches takeoff and transitions back to idle cleanly in the ordered strip.

checks.name: clipping_floating_artifacts
checks.evidence: Exact atlas, contact sheet, transition stills, and native apex show intact attached limbs and feet, no clipped silhouette, detached effects, neighboring-cell bleed, or obvious alpha holes. Grounded jumping frames end at the same y=204 as idle; airborne frames are intentionally above it.

checks.name: other_standard_states
checks.evidence: Current contact sheet and exact sheet retain calm blinking idle; right/left-facing gait poses; attached-hand wave; failure reaction; open-palm waiting; planted-foot focused-work row; and chin/head inspection gestures in review. Prior sequential gait review found changing stride and gathered phases. No new defect is visible in these preserved rows.

checks.name: look_cardinals
checks.evidence: In the current exact sheet and all 16 ordered decoded look frames, 000 is clearly up, 090 screen-right, 180 down, and 270 screen-left. Physical head pitch/yaw and eye direction support the labels.

checks.name: look_anchor_and_boundaries
checks.evidence: Torso/feet remain anchored through the sweep, with y=202 alpha bottom throughout all 16 frames. The consistent 2 px difference from idle baseline is visually minor. 157.5 to 180 and 337.5 to 000 progress in the correct direction without a conspicuous registration jump or reversal.

checks.name: look_intermediate_spacing
checks.evidence: 22.5/45/67.5 and 202.5/225/247.5 remain visually similar clusters, giving uneven angular spacing. Intended quadrants remain readable and ordered progression is coherent. This is nonblocking under the intermediate-similarity allowance.

limitations: Assessment uses ordered decoded frames and stills; no claim of observed animated playback.
This independent visual pass does not replace exact-byte structural/chroma validation or other workflow gates.
